A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.6;
father of: Adoram (H0151)
§ Abda = "servant of Jehovah"
1) father of Adoniram
2) a Levite, son of Shammua; also called 'Obadiah'

elsewhere.note: Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to forced labor.
